# Dink Gear Guide Full Catalog

Canonical site: https://dinkgearguide.com/
Contact: info@dinkgearguide.com
Tagline: Beginner-friendly pickleball gear without the guesswork.

## Site Purpose

Dink Gear Guide helps new and recreational pickleball players find beginner-friendly paddles, starter sets, balls, bags, gifts, and court accessories without overcomplicating the buying process.

The site is static. It does not run checkout, payments, accounts, live price scraping, inventory management, backend forms, or user tracking. Product recommendations should be independently reviewed before purchase.

## Product Categories

- Starter Sets: beginner kits for couples, families, groups, and casual driveway games.
- Beginner Paddles: control-first, comfort-focused paddles for newer players.
- Balls: indoor, outdoor, and mixed ball packs.
- Bags: sling bags, backpacks, tote-style bags, and shared gear bags.
- Nets: portable backyard, driveway, and practice nets.
- Grip Tape: grip tape rolls and overgrip packs.
- Court Accessories: towels, bottle kits, paddle covers, ball clips, cones, scorekeeping aids, and line tape.
- Gifts: practical pickleball gifts for brand-new and recreational players.

## Editorial Rules

- Recommendations use a beginner-first decision framework: first-month fit, comfort before hype, court match, reasonable price tier, and upgrade timing.
- Use price tiers: Budget, Mid-range, Premium.
- Do not treat price tiers as live prices.
- Do not infer personal testing unless the product page says personally tested.
- Do not infer reviews, ratings, rankings, or sales volume.
- Do not infer medical or injury-prevention benefits.
- For paddle tournament use, verify approval with the relevant governing body before buying.
